title.zh: 材料准备接入重复链状生成
title.en: Prepared material joins recurrent chain formation

claim.zh: 先前实际路由输出经逐项接合形成可分割链；保留内部边的两个片段经同一接合规律各自重建，任意有限轮次可在明确共同材料及支持预算内执行。
claim.en: The previous actual routing output forms a cleavable chain through tokenwise attachment; its internally connected fragments rebuild under the same attachment law, with every finite number of rounds executable within explicit shared material/support budgets.

hypotheses.zh: A/B 末端相容、八组分路径的中心切分及操作次序给定；初始已完成路由输出没有未表示承重边。
hypotheses.en: A/B end compatibility, central cleavage of an eight-component path and operation order are supplied; the completed routing output has no unrepresented load-bearing edges.

hypotheses.zh: 一条完整链继续 g 轮另需 8(2^g−1) 组分和 9(2^g−1) 支持；从路由材料激活结构另需八单位支持。
hypotheses.en: Continuing one complete chain for g rounds requires 8(2^g−1) additional components and 9(2^g−1) support; structural activation from routed material additionally requires eight support units.

correspondence.zh: 结构由实际移入、形成边、过滤旧边及保留片段构成。新接合途径与旧分裂生长仅有已检查的端点对应。
correspondence.en: Structure consists of actual token transfers, formed edges, filtered old edges and retained fragments. The new attachment route and old division growth have only the checked endpoint correspondence.

detail.zh: prepared_repeated_generation 使用 completed_routing_output 和既有 route_trace_projection 接通。
detail.en: prepared_repeated_generation uses completed_routing_output and the inherited route_trace_projection to compose the interface.

output.zh: 成功路由轨迹的实际 placed 序列。
output.en: Actual placed sequence from a successful routing trace.

input.zh: 逐项接合的共享材料池。
input.en: Shared component pool for tokenwise attachment.

conditions.zh: 给定路由能力、无未表示承重边、另供八单位初始接合支持及明示后续库存。
conditions.en: Supplied routing capability, no unrepresented load-bearing edges, eight additional activation-support units and explicit subsequent stock.

detail.zh: formed_graph_matches_previous 与 fragments_retain_real_links 核对已生成图及真实分割；不复用旧概率为长期增长。
detail.en: formed_graph_matches_previous and fragments_retain_real_links check the formed graph and actual split; old probabilities are not reused as long-term growth.

output.zh: 先前实际链状图与中心断裂的成员分割。
output.en: Previous actual chain graph and central-cut member partition.

input.zh: 本轮接合终点与保留内部连接的片段。
input.en: New attachment endpoint and internally connected fragments.

conditions.zh: 限于已核对链类及两种形成途径的端点对应；不等同局部规律或成本。
conditions.en: Only the checked chain class and endpoint correspondence between formation routes; local laws and costs are not identified.

detail.zh: 少一单位支持留下真实七组分后继；缺 B 仍有支持也停滞。未证明组织规律的可遗传变异、真实力学、自供材料或广泛比较优势。
detail.en: One missing support unit leaves a real seven-component successor; absence of B stalls despite remaining work. Heritable variation in organizing laws, physical mechanics, autonomous feed and broad comparative advantage are unproved.

limitations.zh: 少一单位支持留下真实七组分后继；缺 B 仍有支持也停滞。未证明组织规律的可遗传变异、真实力学、自供材料或广泛比较优势。
limitations.en: One missing support unit leaves a real seven-component successor; absence of B stalls despite remaining work. Heritable variation in organizing laws, physical mechanics, autonomous feed and broad comparative advantage are unproved.

validation_scope.zh: 所列 Lean 回执绑定实际源码；推论有效性与生物对应分列。
validation_scope.en: The cited Lean receipt binds the actual source; inference validity and biological correspondence remain distinct.

next_delta.zh: 当前固定规律下的结构接续完成；下一连接是改变接合／断裂关系的可遗传差异怎样形成，并改变重复接续与选择。
next_delta.en: Structural continuation under the current fixed law is complete. Next is formation of heritable differences in attachment/cleavage relations and their effects on repeated continuation and selection.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：按本轮实际审读及所列回执登记范围；原证明和反例保持。
history.en: 2026-10-08: recorded the actually reviewed scope and cited receipt, preserving original proofs and counterexamples.

history.zh: 本轮新增31项定理／47项声明审计，373项闭包审计中326项继承声明另计；旧成果迁移不计新定理。
history.en: This continuation adds 31 theorems / 47 declaration audits; 326 inherited declarations are separate within the 373-audit closure. Migration adds no theorem.
